parts.title: [Actual Test] The Pearl
parts.passageHtml:
{[A.][167896]} {[The pearl has always had a special status in the rich and powerful all through the history.][167897]} {[For instance, women from ancient Rome went to bed with pearls on them, so that they could remind themselves how wealthy they were after waking up.][167914]} {[ Pearls used to have more commercial value than diamonds until jewellers learnt to cut gems.][167941]} {[In the eastern countries like Persia, ground pearl powders could be used as a medicine to cure anything including heart diseases and epilepsy.][167957]}

{[B. Pearls can generally be divided into three categories: natural, cultured and imitation.][167997]} {[When an irritant (such as a grain of sand) gets inside a certain type of oyster, mussel, or clam, the mollusc will secrete a fluid as a means of defence to coat the irritant.][168011]} {[Gradually, layers are accumulated around the irritant until a lustrous natural pearl is formed.][168040]}

{[C. A cultured pearl undergoes the same process.][168055]} {[There is only one difference between cultured pearls and natural ones: in cultured pearls, the irritant is a head called ‘mother of pearl’ and is placed in the oyster through surgical implantation.][168063]} {[This results in much larger cores in cultivated pearls than those in natural pearls.][168095]} {[ As long as there are enough layers of nacre (the secreted fluid covering the irritant) to create a gorgeous, gem-quality pearl; the size of the nucleus wouldn’t make a difference to beauty or durability.][168110]}

{[D. Pearls can come from both salt and freshwater sources.][168143]} {[Typically, pearls from salt water usually have high quality, although several freshwater pearls are considered high in quality, too.][168154]} {[In addition, freshwater pearls often have irregular shapes, with a puffed rice appearance.][168174]} {[Nevertheless, it is the individual merits that determine the pearl’s value more than the sources of pearls.][168187]} {[Saltwater pearl oysters are usually cultivated in protected lagoons or volcanic atolls, while most freshwater cultured pearls sold today come from China.][168205]} {[There are a number of options for producing cultured pearls: use fresh water or sea water shells, transplant the graft into the mantle or into the gonad, add a spherical bead or do it nonbeaded.][168227]}

{[E. No matter which method is used to get pearls, the process usually takes several years.][168259]} {[Mussels must reach a mature age, which may take up almost three years, and then be transplanted an irritant.][168275]} {[When the irritant is put in place, it takes approximately another three years for a pearl to reach its full size.][168293]} {[Sometimes, the irritant may be rejected.][168314]} {[As a result, the pearl may be seriously deformed, or the oyster may directly die from such numerous complications as diseases.][168321]} {[At the end of a 5- to 10-year circle, only half of the oysters may have made it through.][168341]} {[Among the pearls that are actually produced in the end, only about 5% of them will be high-quality enough for the jewellery makers.][168358]}

{[F. Imitation pearls are of another different story.][168383]} {[The Island of Mallorca in Spain is renowned for its imitation pearl industry.][168392]} {[In most cases, a bead is dipped into a solution made from fish scales.][168407]} {[But this coating is quite thin and often wears off.][168420]} {[One way to distinguish the imitation pearls is to have a bite on it.][168431]} {[Fake pearls glide through your teeth, while the layers of nacre on the real pearls feel gritty.][168445]}

{[G. Several factors are taken into account to evaluate a pearl: size, shape, colour, the quality of surface and luster.][168464]} {[Generally, the three types of pearls come in such order (with the value decreasing): natural pearls, cultured pearls and imitation pearls (which basically are worthless).][168485]} {[For jewellers, one way to tell whether a pearl is natural or cultured is to send it to a gem lab and perform an X-ray on it.][168513]} {[High-quality natural pearls are extremely rare.][168538]} {[Japan’s Akoya pearls are one of the glossiest pearls out there, while the’ south sea water of Australia is a cradle to bigger pearls.][168545]}

{[H. Historically, the pearls with the highest quality around the globe are found in the Persian Gulf, particularly around Bahrain.][168582]} {[These pearls have to be hand-harvested by divers with no advanced equipment.][168602]} {[Unfortunately, when the large reserve of oil was discovered in the early 1930s, Persian Gulf’s natural pearl industry came to a sudden end because the contaminated water destroyed the once pristine pearls.][168615]} {[In the present days, India probably has the largest stock of natural pearls.][168648]} {[However, it is quite an irony that a large part of India’s slock of natural pearls are originally from Bahrain.][168662]}

questionSets.title: Questions 1-4
questionSets.instructionHtml: Reading Passage 1 has eight paragraphs, A-H. Which paragraph contains the following information?

questions.text: Ancient stories around pearls and its customers
questions.explanationHtml:
A

“ancient stories around pearls and its customers”: những câu chuyện xa xưa về ngọc trai và những người sử dụng nó

Giải thích: Đoạn A có đề cập phụ nữ thời La Mã (Rome) đeo ngọc trai khi ngủ, và người Ba Tư (Persia), người ta lấy bột ngọc trai làm thuốc → đây chính là 2 nền văn minh cổ đại.

E

“difficulties in cultivating process”: những khó khăn trong quá trình nuôi cấy ngọc trai

Giải thích: Đoạn E liệt kê ra một số trở ngại trong quá trình nuôi cấy ngọc trai: tốn nhiều năm (takes several years), ngọc bị biến dạng (seriously deformed), trai chết (may directly die), tỉ lệ ngọc đạt tiêu chuẩn thấp (only about 5%)

questions.text: Factors which decide the value of natural pearls
questions.explanationHtml:
G

“factors which decide the value of natural pearls”: những yếu tố quyết định giá trị của ngọc trai tự nhiên

Giải thích: Đoạn G nhắc đến những tiêu chuẩn để đánh giá một viên ngọc gồm: kích cỡ (size), hình dạng (shape), chất lượng bề mặt (quality of surface), và độ bóng (luster) → viên ngọc nào cũng được đánh giá theo tiêu chí này → và giá trị đi từ cao đến thấp (with the value decreasing): ngọc tự nhiên, ngọc nuôi cấy, ngọc giả

questions.text: A growth mechanism that distinguishes cultured pearls from natural ones
questions.explanationHtml:
C

“a growth mechanism that distinguishes cultured pearls from natural ones”: một cơ chế hình thành ngọc giúp phân biệt ngọc trai nuôi cấy với ngọc trai tự nhiên

Giải thích: Đoạn C giải thích rằng khác với ngọc trai tự nhiên, “hạt sạn” được đưa vào bên trong con trai thông qua giải phẫu (through surgical implantation) → cho ra lõi ngọc hơn (much larger cores)

questionSets.title: Questions 5-10
questionSets.instructionHtml:
Complete the summary below. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the passage for each answer. 

Write your answers in boxes 5-10 on your answer sheet.
questionSets.contentHtml: In history, pearls have had great importance within the men of wealth and power, which were treated as gems for women in ______ Also, pearls were even used as a medicine for people in ______ There are essentially three types of pearls: natural, cultured and imitation. Most freshwater cultured pearls sold today come from China while ______ Island is famous for its imitation pearl industry. Good-quality natural pearls are exceedingly unusual. ______ often manufactures some of the glitteriest pearls while ______ produces larger size ones due to the favourable environment along the coastline. In the past, ______ in Persian Gulf produced the world’s best pearls. Nowadays, the major remaining suppliers of natural pearls belong to India.

questions.explanationHtml:
ancient Rome

“… which were treated as gems for women in 5 …………”: những viên ngọc trai được phụ nữ ở 5 ………. xem như đá quý.

Giải thích: Bài có nói phụ nữ ở LA MÃ CỔ ĐẠI (ANCIENT ROME) đeo ngọc trai kể cả khi ngủ → họ xem ngọc trai là rất quý hiếm. Ở đây bạn nhớ điền cả “ancient” nhé, để tránh nhầm lẫn với thủ đô Rome hiện tại của Ý.

Persia

“Also, pearls were even used as a medicine for people in 6 ………………”: Ngọc trai cũng được dùng như thuốc cho người dân ở 6…………

Giải thích: người dân BA TƯ (PERSIA) dùng bột ngọc trai để chữa heart diseases (bệnh tim) và epilepsy (động kinh)

Mallorca

“Most freshwater cultured pearls sold today come from China while 7…………… Island is famous for its imitation pearl industry.”: hầu hết trai nuôi cấy nước ngọt đến từ Trung Quốc, còn đảo 7……… thì nổi tiếng với ngành chế tác ngọc trai giả.

Giải thích: Đảo Mallorca “nổi tiếng” (is renowned) nhờ vào ngành làm ngọc giả.

Japan

“8……………………. often manufactures some of the glitteriest pearls”: 8……..….. thường sản xuất ra những viên ngọc lấp lánh nhất.

Giải thích: Ngọc Akoya của NƯỚC NHẬT (JAPAN) là một trong những loại ngọc SÁNG NHẤT (GLOSSIEST).

Australia

“9…………………… produces larger size ones due to the favourable environment along the coastline.”: 9………. sản xuất ra những viên ngọc to hơn nhờ môi trường thuận lợi ở bờ biển.

Giải thích: vùng biển phía Nam NƯỚC ÚC (AUSTRALIA) là “cái nôi” cho ra đời những viên ngọc to hơn (a cradle to bigger pearls).

Bahrain

“In the past, 10…………………… in Persian Gulf produced the world’s best pearls.”: trong quá khứ, 10……… ở eo biển Ba Tư cho ra những viên ngọc trai tốt nhất thế giới.

Giải thích: Theo lịch sử (historically), những viên ngọc chất lượng tốt nhất đến từ eo biển Ba Tư, cụ thể là xung quanh vùng BAHRAIN (particularly around BAHRAIN).

questionSets.title: Questions 11-13
questionSets.instructionHtml:
Do the following statements agree with the information given in Reading Passage 1?
In boxes 11-13 on your answer sheet, write:

TRUE               if the statement is true

FALSE              if the statement is false

NOT GIVEN    if the information is not given in the passage

questions.text: Generally speaking, the centre of cultured pearl is significantly larger than that of a natural pearl.
questions.explanationHtml:
TRUE

“Generally speaking, the centre of cultured pearl is significantly larger than that of a natural pearl.”: nhìn chung thì nhân của ngọc trai nuôi cấy to hơn nhân của ngọc trai tự nhiên.

Giải thích: nhờ vào việc cấy ghép hạt nhân bằng phẫu thuật → dẫn đến lõi ngọc trai nuôi cấy to hơn (much larger cores in cultivated pearls) so với ngọc tự nhiên (than those in natural pearls).

questions.text: Sometimes, fake pearls can be more expensive.
questions.explanationHtml:
NOT GIVEN

“Sometimes, fake pearls can be more expensive.”: Đôi khi ngọc trai giả có thể đắt tiền hơn.

Giải thích: bài có đề cập việc ngọc giá về cơ bản là không có giá trị, nhưng cũng KHÔNG ĐỀ CẬP là có trường hợp nào thì sẽ đắt hơn ngọc thật không?

questions.text: The size of the pearls produced in Japan is usually smaller than those in Australia.
questions.explanationHtml:
TRUE

“The size of the pearls produced in Japan is usually smaller than those in Australia.”: Kích cỡ ngọc trai ở Nhật nhỏ hơn ngọc ở Úc.

Giải thích: vùng biển Nam Úc là “cái nôi” cho ra đời những viên ngọc TO HƠN (BIGGER pearls - mình ngầm hiểu là đang so với ngọc Nhật Bản) → suy ra ngọc Nhật Bản bé hơn → TRUE
